title: ControlNet: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
description: Controlling diffusion model outputs beyond text — by pose, depth map, edge map, segmentation — required fine-tuning the entire model. ControlNet freezes the original model and trains a trainable copy of the encoder with "zero convolution" layers, so control signals can be injected without disrupting the pretrained weights. One GPU, 50 hours of training.
